Class ApiKeyService

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.apikey.ApiKeyService
public class ApiKeyService extends Object
Service for creating and managing API key credentials.

Each key is a prefixed opaque string (who_<43 URL-safe Base64 chars>) carrying 256 random bits. Only the SHA-256 hash of the raw key is stored — the raw key is returned once and never persisted.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public String create(Identity identity, String name)
      Generates a new API key for the given identity, stores its hash, and returns the raw key.

      This is the only opportunity to retrieve the raw key — it is not stored anywhere.

      Parameters:
      identity - the identity to link the new credential to
      name - a human-readable label for this key (e.g. "Production server")
      Returns:
      the raw API key (e.g. who_...), never stored

    • revoke

      @Transactional public void revoke(UUID credentialId)
      Revokes an API key: deletes the credential and its identity link, so the key stops resolving.
      Parameters:
      credentialId - the id of the API key credential
